summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue by handling cases where all values are non-finite, but it may introduce unexpected behavior for other edge cases.

issues.description: The patch assumes that returning the first value when all values are non-finite is always correct, which may not be true for all use cases.
The patch introduces a new file `reproduce.py` without proper documentation or comments, which could make it harder for future contributors to understand the purpose of the file.
